recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, moody group portrait featuring three men seated in ornate, high-backed leather chairs against a backdrop of damask wallpaper and empty gilded frames. The aesthetic blends modern fashion with Victorian gothic elements, utilizing heavy vignetting and a desaturated, warm-tinted color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical arrangement of three subjects forming a central triangle
Repetition of empty rectangular frames creating a rhythmic background grid
Contrast between the dark, textured background and the warm, metallic highlights of the frames and typography
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the subjects' presence and authority
coreInvariants: Heavy dark vignetting around the edges
Desaturated skin tones with high-contrast shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects seated side-by-side, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame; the central figure is slightly elevated.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central seated figure and the large ornate title at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top script text, moves down to the central figure, then outward to the flanking figures, finally settling on the bottom emblem.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and textured; very little 'empty' space, filled with wallpaper patterns and frame outlines.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black providing the base shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted gold and bronze for the frames and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle deep red and sepia tones in the floor and leather upholstery.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast; bright highlights on metallic surfaces against near-black shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit blues and greens to near-black shades

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Elegant copperplate script and slab serif
letterConstructionRules: Top text uses high-contrast strokes with exaggerated, swirling swashes on capitals
Bottom text uses a condensed, heavy slab serif with internal inline detailing
Metallic texture applied to all glyphs to simulate 3D gold leaf
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended tails on 'R' and 'F' to frame the word
Custom filigree crest surrounding the bottom text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between fluid, organic script and rigid, geometric slab serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant swash style of the top text.
Provides the sturdy, traditional slab serif foundation for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark room with three ornate Victorian leather chairs. The wall behind is dark blue damask wallpaper decorated with several empty, mismatched gilded picture frames. The floor is dark wood. Use low-key lighting with heavy vignetting and a sepia-toned color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, elegant gold script title at the top center. At the bottom center, place a condensed slab-serif word inside a complex, symmetrical baroque filigree crest. Apply a 3D metallic gold bevel effect to all text.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting moody and low-key?
Are the frames empty and gilded?
Is the typography metallic and beveled?
Does the background feature a damask pattern?

adjustableVariables: Number of frames in the background
Intensity of the sepia/warm color cast
Complexity of the bottom filigree crest
Pose and clothing style of the subjects
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Exact wording of the original titles

mustAchieve: Rich, tactile textures in leather and wood
Consistent metallic sheen on all gold elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is garbled or nonsensical
Check that the metallic texture looks consistent across frames and type
Verify the symmetrical balance of the composition
Confirm the vignetting doesn't obscure the central subjects too much
recipe.reuseFormula: Victorian Gothic + Modern Portraiture + Gilded Metallics + Damask Textures
